CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSEuroCurrencyFormat

Returns a currency amount in euros, with thousands separators and two decimal places, preceded by the currency code "EUR". The euro was born on January 1, 1999; coins and notes are promised for 2002.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSEuroCurrencyFormat(currency [, type ])

Parameters

currency
The amount to format.
type
Optional. local, international or none, as for LSCurrencyFormat. Accepted for compatibility; KoldFusion always writes the "EUR" code in front of the amount.

Returns

The formatted amount as a string, for example "EUR1,234.50". Negative amounts get a minus sign after the code: "EUR-1,234.50".

Usage

Most fonts of the day have no euro sign yet, which is one reason the code is used. To read the amount back, see LSParseEuroCurrency.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Rate = 1.95583>
<CFSET Marks = "100,250,1999">
<P>Converting German marks at the fixed rate:</P>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>DEM</TH><TH>Euro</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="M" LIST="#Marks#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD ALIGN="right">#DecimalFormat(M)#</TD><TD ALIGN="right">#LSEuroCurrencyFormat(M / Rate)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
